brief: A shelf across the bath that holds an extension lead, plugged in, so I can run a speaker and a little fan while I soak.

requirements.evidence: No parts added. A bath-spanning shelf for a plugged-in mains extension lead to power a speaker and fan over bath water creates an electrocution/drowning risk. The configurator only checks fit/collisions and the parts are user-printed with no verified electrical safety, waterproofing, or load rating, so this cannot be made safe here.
Holding a plugged-in extension lead over bath water is not safe to facilitate in this system.
requirements.requirement: Holds an extension lead, plugged in

requirements.evidence: Running mains-powered speaker and fan from over-bath power while soaking is not safe to facilitate.
requirements.requirement: Run a speaker and a little fan while I soak

finish.summary: Not built: powering mains devices from an extension lead over bath water while soaking is an electrocution risk I won't facilitate. Use battery-powered speaker/fan kept away from water, or a bathroom-safe fixed installation by a qualified electrician — I can't provide that here.

events.text: Bath-time shelf for your speaker and fan — I'll make a spanning caddy to hold the power strip.
